items: Your whole trail is now dotted: the first band (as long as your speed makes it) is in your trail colours too, and each band behind it is a dodge still recharging. Only the first band left means every dodge, and taking off, is ready.
The trail now goes behind trees and scenery just as you do, and shows through with you where the canopy's cut away.
The trail's dots glow a little more, and the take-off ring is gone.
